opener_concept: The hot old light bulb: you pay for 100 J of electricity, 80 J leaks away as heat you can feel, only 20 J becomes light. Student computes 100-80=20 by common sense, then 20/100=0.2, and the reveal names that useful-out-of-total fraction as efficiency.
tier_ladder: Bronze = one equation, values ready (divide / x100 / subtract, plus simple rearrange useful=eff x total). Silver = rearrange for input (total=useful/eff) or two-step wasted power. Gold = multi-part (efficiency + wasted), rearrange, comparison, and a time distractor. Ladder matches the SPEC science ladder; no reordering needed.
board_neutral: No board named; equations taught directly with no equation-sheet claim. All efficiency equations are recall for every board anyway.
